key: D minor / modal D, turning to D major in the bell decay
direction: Fresh low-string, wood-and-skin score with the published D–F–E–A–D motif, 60→90 BPM metric modulation, first bell withheld until47.333333. Newly sampled performance and synthesized materials; no original track.

sections.intent: Valley carving, first impression, patient hands, offerings.
3:2 forge pulse and first casting, dead stop on failed note.
Music silence; crack then faint wind only.
Compass lid and sacrifice, plain cello.
Renewed forge, second pour, one tam-tam, fade to silence.
First and loudest sound: foundry bell alone, valley echoes.
D-major strings in bell decay and final carved line.

provenance: Independent new score and performance. Shared sample and synthesizer tools are attributed; published thematic direction and exact narrative cue times are reference inputs.
